item.title: US sends third aircraft carrier and thousands more troops to Middle East amid Iran war
item.description: The United States is sending a third aircraft carrier and thousands more troops to the Middle East, a U.S. official confirmed Thursday, as President Donald Trump vowed that the seven-month war with Iran would end "right after the election" or sooner. item.title: September Jobs Miss Crushes Fed October Rate-Hike Odds; Stocks, Bonds Rally
item.description: The U.S. economy added just 29,000 jobs in September, far below the 84,000 expected by economists, while the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Friday. item.title: Russian strikes paralyze Kyiv bridges, kill one as mayor warns city is being 'torn apart'
item.description: Russian drone and missile strikes have intensified on Kyiv, killing at least one person and forcing the closure of three major bridges over the Dnipro River, Kyiv Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko said Friday. item.title: Trump expected to name intelligence director Jay Clayton as AI czar
item.description: President Donald Trump is expected to name Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as the White House’s artificial intelligence czar, according to a source familiar with the matter.
